Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and

1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.

Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
 Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
 Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
 Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
 Sudden appearance of springs,

d cracks and ground subsidence

2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Waming period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
F Development ofcracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
)
Slanting oftrees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
F Cracks in the floors and walls ofbuildings which are built at slopes
) Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places ifheavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to move
quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to move
quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to move
quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:

➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.

quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to move
quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to move
quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

n to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
 Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
 Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
 Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
 Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence

➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes

springs

move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.

➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes

the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:

➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.

move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emer

cks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.

springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
Disaster Management Center.

Special Note: During this Landslide Early Warning period, please pay attention to the following:
1. Pay your attention to the following pre landslide signs,
➢ Development of cracks on the ground, deepened cracks and ground subsidence
➢ Slanting of trees, electrical posts, fences and telephone posts
➢ Cracks in the floors and walls of buildings which are built at slopes
➢ Sudden appearance of springs, emerging muddy water, blockage or disappearance of existing
springs
2. People should move immediately away from the areas where they noticed the above pre-landslide signs.
3. Furthermore, people living in landslide susceptible areas should be extra vigilant and should be ready to
move quickly to safe places if heavy rain continues.
Note: Communities are advised to follow the instructions given by National Building Research Organization and
